title: An Update on Orion for Linux and Windows
summary: Kagi releases significant updates to their Orion browser for Linux and Windows platforms, expanding beyond the original macOS-exclusive offering. The update brings performance improvements, UI enhancements, and feature parity across desktop operating systems, maintaining Kagi's privacy-focused and ad-free browsing philosophy.
problem_solved: Brings Kagi's privacy-first, ad-free browsing experience to Linux and Windows users who previously only had macOS access.
why_valuable: democratizes access to a privacy-focused browser alternative across major desktop platforms, challenging the dominance of mainstream browsers.
